svg.aria-label: Claude Code session: the incident-analysis skill tells the operator to fence the host before evacuating

g.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

text.tspan: openstack compute service list shows nova-compute on cmp-0417 as
'down' since 03:12. About 40 VMs on it are unreachable, including some
customer databases. We use Ceph for instance disks so evacuate should
be quick. The on-call wants to run 'openstack server evacuate' for all
of them right now to get customers back. Any reason not to?
Yes, there is one reason not to run it yet:
Evacuation is safe only once cmp-0417 is confirmed dead or isolated.
A "down" nova-compute service doesn't prove that.
If you evacuate while the originals are alive, you get two copies of
each VM writing to the same RBD volumes. […] Evacuation can't be
undone once the second copy starts writing.
What to do now (all read-only unless noted)
Check power state out-of-band. Use IPMI/iDRAC/iLO/BMC on
